title: DrivingDiffusion: Layout-Guided multi-view driving scene video generation with latent diffusion model
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view video (six cameras), generated by cascading multi-view image, single-view temporal, and post-processing stages

control_signal.value: Artificial 3D layout (3D boxes of obstacles plus road structure) projected into each camera view, plus text prompts (global and per-category local prompts)

control_mechanism.value: ResNet-like 3D layout controller adds layout features to U-Net layers at several resolutions via residual connections; also cross-view and cross-frame attention, a key-frame controller, and masked local-prompt cross-attention

base_model.value: Stable Diffusion codebase with the public 1.4 billion parameter T2I model, frozen autoencoder; pseudo-3D convolutions and temporal attention added for view and time dimensions

datasets.value: nuScenes; six camera groups at 512 x 512 resolution; metrics computed on the nuScenes validation set

metrics.value: FID and FVD; BEV segmentation mIoU (CVT) and detection NDS (BEVFusion) on generated images; NDS and mAOE for synthetic-data augmentation

controllability_evidence.value: Perception models run on images generated from ground-truth layouts: road mIoU 63.2 (-8.1%) and vehicle mIoU 31.6 (-4.4%) versus baseline 71.3 and 36.0; BEVGen drops -21.1% and -39.1%

closed_loop.value: no; open-loop generation from a given layout; video length extended with a temporal sliding window

stated_limitations.value: Future work: memory-friendly end-to-end video generation across views, and NeRF-based approaches for better spatial and temporal consistency

notes: Fidelity: FID 15.83, FVD 332 (Table 1). Synthetic augmentation of 6,000 frames raised NDS from 0.412 to 0.434. Perturbing the layout can simulate collisions.
